toolDrawer.notFound: Not found on {{machine}}. Get it with {{hint}}
toolDrawer.path: Path, instead of looking for it
toolDrawer.environment: Extra environment, one NAME=value per line

recordDialog.description: A tool of your own on this machine. Ahab finds it on the machine; it never installs it.

settingErrors.id: The ID is lower-case letters, digits and dashes.
settingErrors.name: Give it a name.
settingErrors.kind: The kind is languageServer, formatter, linter or check.
settingErrors.source: Your own tools have no source: Ahab finds them, never installs them.

tools.title: Language tools
tools.description: Language servers, formatters, linters and checks: Ahab's own, plugins' and yours, with their state here. Ahab installs into its data folder on this machine, never system-wide.

servers.title: Running servers
servers.description: The language servers running here now, with their root.

settings.title: Settings for this machine
settings.description: Paths, extra environment and tools turned off are set per tool: open a tool's name.

maxServers.label: Servers at once
maxServers.help: Unused servers make room when another starts. Open files can keep more running. {{value}} by default.

maxChecks.label: Checks at once
maxChecks.help: Check commands running together on this machine; the rest wait their turn. {{value}} by default.

memoryBudget.label: Memory budget (MiB)
memoryBudget.help: Ahab stops unused language servers when they exceed this budget. Half the machine’s memory when empty.

logTraffic.label: Keep LSP traffic in logs
logTraffic.help: Every message to and from each server, in its Logs. For finding problems; off by default.

projectLsps.intro: Which language tools {{project}} uses. How each tool behaves stays in the project's own files.
projectLsps.introUnnamed: Which language tools this project uses. How each tool behaves stays in the project's own files.
projectLsps.shared: This repository's {{file}} sets these choices for everyone who opens it. What you set here overrides it on this server only.
projectLsps.noMachine: The project's machine is not online: its tools are shown by ID, without checks.

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.description: For projects holding many repositories or worktrees. Pin one in Problems or the Git view.
repositories.serversStartHelp: Each for the root of a file you open; only in pinned repositories; or never.
repositories.activeDaysHelp: A repository is active this long after a file in it was opened or an agent changed one; Problems shows active and pinned ones. {{value}} by default.

turnedOff.title: Problems turned off
turnedOff.description: Plugins' problems this project does not show (turned off from Problems).

environment.title: Environment
environment.direnvHelp: Tools run under an allowed .envrc. On by default.
environment.miseHelp: Tools use .mise.toml or .tool-versions. On by default.
environment.nixHelp: Tools run in the flake's dev shell. Off by default: it can take long to start.
environment.extraHelp: For every tool of this project, one NAME=value per line.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Each language's tools in order of preference: the first that can run wins. Ahab's defaults apply until you change them.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Whole-project checks, such as cargo clippy and tsc, and when each runs.

checkLog.nothing: Check project: no check commands run on request here.

problemsPanel.filterHelp: Words in the message, code, tool or path; globs over paths; ! leaves out; commas between

problemsPanel.running: Running the check commands; this can take a while…
problemsPanel.notCheckedHelp: Not used lately, not pinned and without problems: choose which to check
problemsPanel.empty: No problems have been detected in the project.
problemsPanel.noResults: No results found with the filter.
problemsPanel.noChecks: No check commands run on request here.

checkChooser.title: Check which repositories?

checkChooser.description_other: {{count}} roots have check commands. The machine runs a few at once; the rest wait their turn.

pin.pinHelp: Pin: always active, checked and shown
pin.unpinHelp: Unpin: active again only when used
